newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING confident on 97, too early to forecast.
newsitem.headline: ING confident on 97, too early to forecast.

text.p: Financial services group ING Groep NV (ING) said on Thursday it was confident about 1997 but it was too early to make a profit forecast.
"We are full of confidence for 1997 but, despite a good start, it is still too early for a statement on profit expectations," ING said.
ING earlier announced a net profit of 3.32 billion guilders for 1996, up from 2.65 billion in 1995.
It lifted the dividend to 2.00 guilders per share, from 1.66 guilders in 1995, covered by earnings per share which rose to 4.56 guilders from 3.84.
